# UNEP - UN Environment Programme

> The United Nations Environment Programme leads global environmental action on climate, nature, pollution, and sustainable development.

UNEP is the leading environmental authority within the United Nations system, supporting countries, multilateral processes, scientific assessments, and policy action across major environmental challenges. Its website includes thematic programmes, governance bodies, reports, campaigns, regional work, and practical resources for governments, researchers, media, and the public.

## Main Site and Language Portals
- [UNEP Homepage](https://www.unep.org): Main portal for UNEP programmes, news, campaigns, publications, and institutional information.
- [Arabic](https://www.unep.org/ar): Arabic-language UNEP content covering programmes, news, and environmental priorities.
- [Spanish](https://www.unep.org/es): Spanish-language UNEP portal with regional and global environmental content.
- [French](https://www.unep.org/fr): French-language UNEP portal for programmes, publications, and updates.
- [Portuguese](https://www.unep.org/pt-br): Portuguese-language UNEP content for global and regional audiences.
- [Russian](https://www.unep.org/ru): Russian-language UNEP portal with translated institutional and thematic resources.
- [Chinese](https://www.unep.org/zh-hans): Simplified Chinese UNEP portal with key environmental information and updates.

## Thematic Priorities
- [Climate Change](https://www.unep.org/explore-topics/climate-action): UNEP work on mitigation, adaptation, resilience, and climate policy support.
- [Nature](https://www.unep.org/explore-topics/nature): Programmes focused on biodiversity, ecosystems, restoration, and nature-based solutions.
- [Pollution](https://www.unep.org/explore-topics/pollution): Work on air pollution, chemicals, waste, and marine litter.
- [Disasters and Conflicts](https://www.unep.org/explore-topics/disasters-conflicts): Environmental dimensions of crises, recovery, and conflict-sensitive action.
- [Resource Efficiency](https://www.unep.org/explore-topics/resource-efficiency): Sustainable consumption and production, circularity, and efficient resource use.
- [Environment Under Review](https://www.unep.org/explore-topics/environment-under-review): Science, data, assessments, and environmental monitoring resources.

## Programmes and Initiatives
- [Beat Pollution](https://www.unep.org/beatpollution): UNEP campaign and resources addressing pollution across air, land, and water.
- [World Environment Day](https://www.unep.org/events/un-day/world-environment-day): Annual global campaign page with themes, materials, and participation resources.
- [UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration](https://www.decadeonrestoration.org): Global restoration initiative led by UNEP and partners.
- [International Methane Emissions Observatory](https://www.unep.org/explore-topics/energy/what-we-do/international-methane-emissions-observatory): Methane data and transparency initiative supporting emissions reduction.
- [Global Environment Outlook](https://www.unep.org/resources/global-environment-outlook): Flagship environmental assessment and related reports.
- [Emissions Gap Report](https://www.unep.org/resources/emissions-gap-report): Annual assessment of the gap between climate pledges and required action.
- [Adaptation Gap Report](https://www.unep.org/resources/adaptation-gap-report): UNEP analysis of global adaptation needs, finance, and implementation progress.

## Governance and Institutional Bodies
- [UN Environment Assembly](https://www.unep.org/environmentassembly): UNEP’s governing body, including sessions, resolutions, and participation information.
- [Committee of Permanent Representatives](https://www.unep.org/cpr): Intergovernmental body supporting UNEP governance and member state engagement.
- [About UNEP](https://www.unep.org/about-un-environment): Overview of UNEP’s mandate, structure, leadership, and role in the UN system.
- [Executive Office](https://www.unep.org/executive-office): Information on UNEP leadership and executive management.
- [Evaluation Office](https://www.unep.org/evaluation-office): Independent evaluation resources supporting accountability and organizational learning.
- [Civil Society Unit](https://www.unep.org/civil-society-engagement): Engagement resources for civil society organizations working with UNEP.

## Regions and Country Engagement
- [Africa](https://www.unep.org/regions/africa): Regional priorities, programmes, and environmental updates from Africa.
- [Asia and the Pacific](https://www.unep.org/regions/asia-and-pacific): UNEP regional work across Asia and Pacific countries.
- [Europe](https://www.unep.org/regions/europe): Regional initiatives, partnerships, and policy support in Europe.
- [Latin America and the Caribbean](https://www.unep.org/regions/latin-america-and-caribbean): Regional environmental action and programme information.
- [North America](https://www.unep.org/regions/north-america): UNEP engagement and regional priorities in North America.
- [West Asia](https://www.unep.org/regions/west-asia): Regional environmental programmes and cooperation in West Asia.

## News, Stories, and Media
- [News and Stories](https://www.unep.org/news-and-stories): UNEP newsroom with articles, features, and announcements.
- [Press Releases](https://www.unep.org/news-and-stories/press-release): Official UNEP press releases and institutional announcements.
- [Stories](https://www.unep.org/news-and-stories/story): Feature stories on environmental issues, projects, and impact.
- [Speeches](https://www.unep.org/news-and-stories/speech): Speeches and statements from UNEP leadership and officials.
- [Videos](https://www.unep.org/news-and-stories/video): Video content covering campaigns, events, and environmental topics.
- [Media Centre](https://www.unep.org/news-and-stories/press-release): Entry point for journalists seeking official UNEP updates.

## Publications and Reports
- [Resources](https://www.unep.org/resources): Central library of UNEP reports, publications, and knowledge products.
- [Publications](https://www.unep.org/resources/publication): Browse UNEP publications across thematic and regional areas.
- [Reports](https://www.unep.org/resources/report): UNEP reports, assessments, and analytical outputs.
- [Interactive](https://www.unep.org/resources/interactive): Interactive resources, data-rich explainers, and digital publications.
- [Global Environment Outlook](https://www.unep.org/resources/global-environment-outlook): UNEP’s flagship assessment of the global environmental situation.
- [Frontiers Report](https://www.unep.org/resources/frontiers-report): Emerging environmental issues identified through UNEP scientific analysis.
- [Making Peace with Nature](https://www.unep.org/resources/making-peace-nature): UNEP synthesis report linking climate, biodiversity, and pollution crises.

## Events and Campaigns
- [Events](https://www.unep.org/events): Calendar of UNEP conferences, observances, and public events.
- [World Environment Day](https://www.unep.org/events/un-day/world-environment-day): Global environmental observance led annually by UNEP.
- [International Day of Clean Air for Blue Skies](https://www.unep.org/events/un-day/international-day-clean-air-blue-skies): Campaign resources and event information for clean air action.
- [International Day for the Preservation of the Ozone Layer](https://www.unep.org/events/un-day/international-day-preservation-ozone-layer): Ozone protection observance and awareness materials.
- [UNEA Events](https://www.unep.org/environmentassembly/events): Events and meetings related to the UN Environment Assembly.
- [Campaigns](https://www.unep.org/campaigns): UNEP public campaigns promoting environmental awareness and action.

## Careers, Partnerships, and Support
- [Work with Us](https://www.unep.org/work-with-us): Careers, internships, procurement, and collaboration opportunities with UNEP.
- [Vacancies](https://www.unep.org/work-with-us/vacancies): Current UNEP job opportunities and recruitment information.
- [Internships](https://www.unep.org/work-with-us/internships): Internship information for students and early-career applicants.
- [Procurement](https://www.unep.org/work-with-us/procurement): Supplier and procurement guidance for working with UNEP.
- [Partnerships](https://www.unep.org/partnerships): Information on collaborating with UNEP across sectors and stakeholders.
- [Donate](https://www.unep.org/donate): Ways to financially support UNEP’s environmental work.
